citations.claim: W approach waits 201s at red with queue queued at first violating step 719 during NS green
W already waiting 132s at red while NS green held during active S detector_fail
NS green had just started with W wait only 7s before detector_fail began

counterfactual.change: Removed the single detector_fail event on S (t552 dur204); same steps/params. EW gets recalled and W wait drops to 7s, no violation.

explanation: NS green starts at step ~525. S detector_fail goes active at 552 and stays active through 719. While it is active the actuated controller never ends NS green: it holds NS green continuously (~194s, far past max_green 90) despite growing EW demand, so E/W red waits grow monotonically (33 at 552, 132 at 650) until W hits 201 at 719 violating max_wait. Removing only the detector_fail restores cycling and removes the failure, implicating failed max-out/recall while a same-direction detector is failed.

violation.detail: approach 3 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: The red violating vehicles remain stopped and queued at red through steps 716 to 719 while the cross direction keeps green. No phase switch occurs across the strip, so the waiting bodies are stranded and never discharged.
